BiblicalUsage: Chashal is weakening, crushing, and it appears once, in the image of the fourth kingdom: as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all things, so shall it break in pieces and bruise.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse is a warning in iron: the kingdom that crushes everything will itself be broken.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
